Platform Assessment with weighted scoring methodology
Engagement Analysis and integration health metrics

Content Mix Review with 12 content pillars
file_insights.data_structure: Markdown with tables, charts, and hierarchical organization

file_insights.purpose: Track implementation progress across audit phases

patterns_discovered.description: Platform selection uses formula: (Audience×2 + Content + Gap + Resources + Alignment) / 7
patterns_discovered.application: Enables objective platform prioritization beyond subjective assessment

patterns_discovered.description: Combines TRIBE community framework, 4-1-1 content rule, REACH metrics, and 12 content pillars
patterns_discovered.application: Creates comprehensive, multi-layered strategy addressing all aspects of social presence

patterns_discovered.description: Italian-primary (70%) with English secondary (30%) on LinkedIn, balanced 50-50 on Twitter/X
patterns_discovered.application: Captures local market while maintaining global reach for B2B PM audience

patterns_discovered.description: Three core personas (Leaders, Teams, Aspiring PMs) with specific content and service mappings
patterns_discovered.application: Ensures content relevance and conversion alignment to service offerings

patterns_discovered.description: 10x opportunities ranked by leverage (thought leadership > quick wins > multipliers > tactical)
patterns_discovered.application: Prioritizes high-impact activities within resource constraints

patterns_discovered.description: Current 4-step funnel (Content → Profile → Website → Booking) identified as opportunity for compression to 2-step

gotchas_discovered.issue: Website footer links to @Matt_Selfrules while metadata references @mattiadluca
gotchas_discovered.impact: Broken attribution and confusion in audience navigation

gotchas_discovered.issue: Content strategy score: 0/10 - no documented strategy exists despite active LinkedIn presence
gotchas_discovered.impact: Random content posting without strategic alignment to business goals
gotchas_discovered.resolution_effort: Requires full strategy implementation before scaling

gotchas_discovered.issue: Critical gaps in OG images, social sharing buttons, no follow CTAs, missing LinkedIn Featured section optimization
gotchas_discovered.impact: 70% lower social card engagement and 4-step funnel instead of optimal 2-step

gotchas_discovered.issue: YouTube deprioritized because video production is 5-10x effort for solo practitioner
gotchas_discovered.impact: Short-term operational efficiency but potential long-term brand limitation
gotchas_discovered.resolution_effort: Revisit only if launching podcast or course

gotchas_discovered.issue: Current community health: 1/10 foundation phase, no active engaged audience
gotchas_discovered.impact: Requires intentional community design and relationship investment before viral potential

gotchas_discovered.issue: Only <50 active PM thought leaders in Italian LinkedIn space creates opportunity but also lack of competitive benchmarks
gotchas_discovered.impact: Less reference material for best practices and audience growth potential harder to predict
gotchas_discovered.resolution_effort: Requires original strategy design without Italian PM playbook

Implement TRIBE community framework tactics daily

Develop content calendar using 12 pillar framework

Implement 20% effort allocation (content repurposing, not original)
Use for PM community networking and engagement

recommendations.recommendation: Pursue Italian PM thought leadership position
actions: Maintain consistent LinkedIn presence and engagement
Develop signature frameworks unique to bilingual PM journey
Target speaking invitations and collaboration opportunities

recommendations.recommendation: Track and optimize using REACH metrics
actions: Monitor monthly: Reach (500-5K impressions), Engagement (3-30 comments), Amplification (1-15 reposts), Conversion (10-200 clicks), Holding (5-100 return commenters)
Adjust content pillars based on pillar-level performance
A/B test content hooks from library of 15+ formulas
recommendations.impact: Data-driven optimization ensures continuous improvement toward 6-month goals

recommendations.recommendation: Do not pursue YouTube, Instagram, or TikTok
recommendations.rationale: All scored <5.0 with poor audience fit, high effort requirements, and minimal conversion potential for B2B consulting model
recommendations.revisit_condition: YouTube only if launching podcast/course; Instagram/TikTok only if pivoting business model
